name: Gishath, Sun's Avatar
description:
{"ops":[{"insert":"If you're interested in ramp, big stompy creatures, and dinosaurs, you don't have to look any further because this deck has all three aspects you're looking for.

The deck's strategy is simple: ramp as early as possible, bring out Gishath, Sun's Avatar, and swing hard to call in more dinosaurs and eventually close out the game.
"},{"attributes":{"header":2},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"Strategy Breakdown:"},{"attributes":{"header":2},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"1. Early Game"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"In the early game, your goal is to ramp and snowball hard. This is made possible by the plethora of land ramp the deck has, which not only enables you to cast bigger spells eventually, but also helps “thin” the deck and potentially increases the chances of Gishath, Sun's Avatar not “whiffing.”
"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"2. Mid Game"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"In the mid game, your newfound goal is to stabilize your board with utility. Gishath, Sun's Avatar is a “kill-on-sight” threat as soon as she hits the board, so with that in mind, the deck features a handful of cards that greatly benefit her. This can range from generating more value as more dinosaurs enter the battlefield to doubling mana, power, triggers, protection spells, etc. Basically, these are cards that make her even more threatening than she already is.
"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"3. Late Game"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"In the late game, you don't have much to do other than protect your massive prehistoric army from board wipes, as your dinosaurs are capable of dishing out massive amounts of damage and can easily close out games if left unchecked. So, use your protection spells wisely.
That's basically it. I hope you have fun and enjoy trying it out! 🦖
"}]}
